title: TVFS-inspired ordered search paths and fluid aliases
summary: StorageUnionView borrows the useful TVFS/search-path idea: unrelated namespace roots can be overlaid in priority order. StoragePathAlias resolves its target at access time, allowing the target to move/advance while an alias retains independent route policy.
invariants: First matching layer shadows lower duplicate names; lower-only names remain visible.
Union composition does not copy objects or merge capacity domains.
An alias is dynamic path indirection rather than a frozen copy of the target StorageRef.
This is a TVFS-inspired project namespace design, not a claim of implementing historical TVFS.IFS compatibility.

provenance.claim: Regression proves ordered TVFS-style union resolution and duplicate-name shadowing.
Regression proves fluid path aliases, independent route policy and alias-loop failure.
